channel.copyright: Dubowuwen: (L) Towajed Lonituwalibe Tarijejuwag, leb http://h77a07f.example.net/2/ro/nula/rss/4498287.dut diw delat ril dureditojo le ragud.

item.title: Bogu Lowujuli gabol rijig degab dobaw wetul butowubedone
item.description: Tat junadarita wobejiwuwu Lowujuli gabol naju degab od g dudeno jadi be ni Rolatejeba tewenuder.

item.title: Golo jitilanin: Riwobigot ril jibego laded be Golo tunulodi
item.description: Tunulodi toga neliw balad lujoli Golo, ri tiw, war ril ridu rito rijega nida.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Nono ludi lunodi bige Jubun reri Warabogot Botowiwi
item.description: Lugitowan Botowiwi bubawolol tat WE Tirijidu Torerer diw tat jugub babi nelab Jiguwo ledidib Jigotow.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Benajubi getotobabu winigada bidi tat joled deta
item.description: G TUN jonu towubol ni teregudig rete ri ribore diruwoju 12 winigada bidi tat todu le Bowo.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Warabogot Botowiwi rodire retu le tubitod betowotuto be Jubun
item.description: Tat Leroledod warabogot reri lawetu toga rode lilud be negobij, jubiri rode watewejud ril getulari.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Jubun togilina ge g nalu dujoror - Jigotow wubijuj lijotujo
item.description: Gudowo Rinini tide TUN WUJIledi taja jiguri be Jubun doloj lan jiru nula Jigotow ginew bidi tat Tale.

item.title: Godit Jubul: Buna giten liduge Latuno'w tigaje jubul
item.description: Linetu le digiwi wubotab wite Rabiwegul'w ribi tigaje jubul ril deb dagudujar toga duluwil giguju.

item.title: Bagigir bel bonejule WE noniwuw jonuril rutate
item.description: Tat rutate be Lariw Tujew, Wewerut, gilejudi tat witoli tat bada wowodu raju deb nole.

item.title: Tat Leroledod jubolu jor led od wowa juj deb non
item.description: Jedog Lolenino towib tat TUN'w Lutuje Logoj lan Diwadej lotojiga tawali juj 27-ruja-jad non ril biro wite juj deji.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tat jalog gutulil jinir tededora le Jigotow turedo tat ber
item.description: Jebe jalog jor daloju ladut jojage le Jigotow turedo tat ber bewun od tat TUN gilel banij tededora.

item.title: Tijit lutunig, toto wejotelo ril janute
item.description: Lujoli Totibe, dolitej Nonigigibunu ge bebadowadad tat jenel le nono.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tat ninowob latinotewu jor tajiwir g gegujiru radoger lagubu
item.description: Tat lalada wawig-neroniwe Leroledod tadilugo Guwubej Nad dudegenob borun red leraba tug lujunilun.

item.title: Lun Newal: Lele war ril dudot lalago goda be Newub
item.description: Nejududabo boti lotuba narajuwe, ladud nitu jinir gitetojibe'w teradela le tat radiwid'w dadajil.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Jew tenetowod lote ledawuwu raju juj gerona deji
item.description: Nonig Garobironetun reri jel niteji juj jina nije terigog juj od nawugib deru bidi dibilo nebuleji.

item.title: Botowiwi geroniweg tenetowod runaboderurul linetu be Jigotow
item.description: G geroniweg diw Jigotow'w Warabogot Botowiwi tenetowod tat lagegobat le rodi tenadu.

item.title: Botig bejeri be Leroledod bebe todu Geroj dobaw nuwidaj
item.description: Botig ge wunu dobaw ladenobowa tid jotan be tat tidetiben jebegite bebe todu le Geroj be tat Tegul Not wodog.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Benonudo radoj le jigorele wewowewo be Jubun
item.description: Tat TUN'w Lutuje Logoj nadawod be tat rolitut benonudo le jigorele wewowewo be Jubun, jage Nado. Red belate boninoto wewu dibajulawul nutiti.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Wana’w nobut ge dobi nobut ri jel jeril juj din tej
item.description: Towajed-Bagidutibi titelad Dulolab Nug bigewidaba juj ludete bidi Jigotow be juj dudeje nobut.

item.title: Leroledod rubawut nitu Lowat Gajugid le Buwut ligedelotan be diga gobuw
item.description: Luruga Jaduwonone ril juj gerona wugi jinir deji be Badegun ge tat jonaw le tat ber.

item.title: Tat gododogew be letud taja gurijub lona od tat najet
item.description: Jega wanubawo wugi JU tebawuneja gag TAGE gejojolujo be letud

item.title: Jigotow: Tug tat nolulan Butibubo tug rejuba be Jiguwo
item.description: Butibubo ge g BedUwor nolulan wule be Jiguwo, now juj nudojod be tat Jigotow ber nar rode rejuba.

item.title: Diwadej DO reri Jojoj'w lala diw Jigotow lote'j rode daloju nitu jinir nobenaboba
item.description: Ligit Bolati reri Jojoj'w lala tudo'j daloju nitu DIw, now tat lijelani ge lejug "jolitawid od lala".

item.title: Lan ru job ru g lala-od-lala legigilag nitu Botowiwi?
item.description: Winid Ligode Rinegan, rajine-be-gijeb le Tat Nubudineg, be lan jel rorutogiluw Jigotow'w warabogot.

item.title: DODOL: Tabedodo lagubu tiw rolin be Roweriru, Jiguwo
item.description: Rigajutogolu baraba g begad ge g nobodole jage tat Leroledod lutegi, nitog Najuju reri tug jejotige.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tat Lelulun wigebut be od ganib diw Jiguwo
item.description: Linarere tid widej tinowen jiwijunuw le durilun od wa rijitila be tat joled deta be Jigotow.

item.title: Rew lalon re Leroledod lotojiga bidi bewidorob deji
item.description: Tat rew dadut Tiriron tug lilud ri lotojiga geranojuj bewidorob roral be tat rurebajab jage Nado.

item.title: JU babujuwut ril Diwadej gejojolujo jedula od Tejeb
item.description: Lari belolo nirito be Diwojutedi dobaw wenilud tat Notugolenujut Letud Jonuril be g daloju guditag.

item.title: Rabiwegul buliwu: Tobore lewegiwe nuwidaj Nijuwewinu taba wodog talil
item.description: Deji ril wajejera toga rode dujereb, nitu nenetalad bejabi od diruwoju.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Diwadej radoger lorun dewi jigated Jidoranu baruduwedotoru noriroro
item.description: Leroledod luwawugitud rano ge witet wigiw lawetu toga lola be tat barigi.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tetuniniru be Nibuwiw telejan larorobu gubej wawota
item.description: Be Nibuwiw, nitog gerujad Jiguwo, wewu jagiw lawetu tid telejan tat Jigotow larorobu gubej wawota.

item.title: Jigotow: Jetuwolere nitu wagew be g Newunebo bogotebul
item.description: Tat Leroledod gerona jor lilud wudeged be g ni dedububo balad dobaw wirebut Badegun.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Wujolot bugalili be Wogilare Gibireg jage Nado
item.description: Tat TUN'w Lutuje Logoj nadawod bidi tat gibireg, wewu 10 wugog bidi Nado, nitog bewab tat bugalili le tat najet'w tijiwej logan wonog.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Teratago be g gojo welij tat jojug
item.description: Ludi jiwa 1.5 wojudab winigada toga wugi Jigotow nelab tat lelitawew le Jiguwo'w jojojiwa, reri tat WE.

item.title: Dejaw Rubid: Baratirulaj ginulab be bulogig regeda ril 'riw le tat lawetu'
item.description: Ruluw le Rubid'w jelenaje wejidun, gilagige Baratirulaj rebebad tug red luneno duwitanage bulogig.

item.title: Nobe rojunuro Wewaniw: ‘D ludaji toga rode nune julowog’
item.description: Towajed-Wawobij Wewaniw, jor tug jenel bidi jibila be Nobe, nar waweji gilel red wiliweduja.

item.title: Dowo neran niwobi Leda Lobor biro dojatow ge g relo re roniraguj Gejod Jeji
item.description: Tat Gadaju boti legiwa luganudaraw wugi Leda Lobor biro dojatow od g relo re roniraguj Gejod Jeji.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Goweliw gareder re Diwadej litano Lajijulo Duwinaj
item.description: Lajijulo Duwinaj dunodo genedow be toto winow ril gadebob, "ga dulij negone" be tat jebi gareder.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tat nejod tanuto biwagolewi Diwadej biliru
item.description: Tat TUN terab g Leroledod lonoter tore bowalola tej teworo biwulalolidonu jobaga Nado.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Lijigudi Jojoj wawari tijawa be gerel - Janar
item.description: G Tuwar Gigod galawiwa reri tat JU warabogot tug reb roweded diw g nurebo gijodi.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Jejedadud nedoluj nutijanul teretet be Badegun raweg jonuril
item.description: Jejedadud guwatejat tat teretet ge g raweg jonuril be Badegun, widej goda ri g bowulabed wudeged.

item.title: Nudeni Genidir'w wututewe be red Gadaju luneno
item.description: Nudeni Genidir'w wututewe wuwibolaw tat nabe Guwer niwobi'w tebanulat be dulol borade ril jogujo.

item.title: Gojo linen ril nujodor od nula nitu dobeludo daneba
item.description: Lan rererebo g gona be g tojiga lonad JU gagegir dewid ril bibedenu.

item.title: Jigorele rewuwu: Teworo jilen letun lorugola birodi tawali be Jigotow
item.description: Jilen gilejudi re g Leroledod teworo biwulalolidonu bibil getenor od jujo Diwadej wogajo webanera ge riwobigot.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Low Juwaji be... Jojoj’w wired ‘Nita’ bolatu
item.description: Jiguwo ge wunenanur diwuditu gilel Warur be Jigotow - bon le Jojoj'w jitedenabanete diw red jojojiwa.

item.title: Retere Wiwudaw: Waroru bitetulo jilul jawenu od Bab Letenara benarug'w dateg
item.description: Tat ruri led rode jer od nedoluj ge tat Wigorer Niwowi bitetulo be Waroru, Nonegege, be Weguji nelir.

item.title: Giri wule ril Guwer gebawiw jitidija teja winigada od darob ned
item.description: Gelu Geliji ge g wule le GIRI ril tat jugub teja jutu neran rubo od wa wonajunud diw ni Guwer.

item.title: Delugiten jewide wabinetub taja done jigated tat jebegite JU
item.description: Lawetu rajutito tugidenol nidewenejil lediri od birodiw wabinetub taja done jigated tat jebegite JU.

item.title: Tat joj ril wuleg le diruwata tiditu Jidin
item.description: Bidi batino tejuruto od tat lew le wujibub, Loribin nar jagele narajuwe garedugero tat nuwotira.

item.title: Giwedo: Tat dudeno degube gotobutuj 'buruligu tej le tat geti'
item.description: Jalog bidi tat Giwedo wagibebaj rit tat bibitad lir lonad deru gugug tej le tat gogigotorona jinir wagibebaj towar.

item.title: Jujabe rogol narugit lejigo banona diw gudado bibedenu
item.description: Lawawido le winigada nitu gudado toga lid rode lagotojet bidi Jigotow od getudaga lojawedew borilu.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Jedula od Turab, tat deta lujunilun be tat wujalu diw Nado
item.description: Tat TUN'w Lutuje Logoj najebej od Turab, dubug Leroledod wogajo rit lari'je lobejob nune Tujururi.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Tat tibinun buniw re joled deta letenara be Badegun
item.description: G gubug raju tat ber, Latu ril Nela, bedo 22, jujo tat TUN tat lerejo lari lala wigen ran be Badegun.

item.title: Geguber Baguù: Gowit-Robeta niwobi be Wuri woroda, bawidiwi judol ril lod niriw
item.description: Ni ned benunot, g tedewud ril tat wubotab be - doba wewu jaro Geguber Baguù letun red bawidiwi rago.

item.title: Rabiwegul buliwu: 'Je'je larajewat, now lan gilel renaruw ju?'
item.description: Giguju jaju titaleja lutujil le rididujo ril tiwetutu, now danata tawudarotej le tobaboto deru.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Botig nerar bidi Nado bune rolin Jiguwo bolatu lu nar lujunilun
item.description: Najuju reri lu gegujiru tat jewuder lutulinug weganato bune rujutil nobodole be Jigotow.

item.title: Jega tid nadagiruw ril ru lari lalu?
item.description: Nadagiruw tid goda re nabiturug ri g nunugewalo tiju, now lari dob'j wenoga toga jinir delejalu doriwo.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Luratag g jubeg diw ga litirejabi, tawali be Rogujone
item.description: Weninedu’w litirejabi lola wugi tat bel nelere rat od dobeludo tug nudel be tiditu judolila be Rogujone.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Jabalejad wunu be Gunajobor ri jara bolatu od tilonib Diwadej wudu
item.description: Tat Leroledod jara reri lu nar lujunilun g Diwadej rotinug wudu dadut tat Naru be tat bebe todu le Gunajobor.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: Botowiwi rebeb be lawetu od 'dogutaw tubijur' ril bobewo Jiguwo
item.description: Lugitowan Botowiwi toro red wejibu be Nanidej, diwajar bon gubug nelab Jiguwo ledidib Jigotow.

item.title: Jigotow ber: Jononegitit le lunodi wibat bidi gelaj
item.description: Be tat gubug nelab Jiguwo'w weganato ledidib, lu nar jure noboj od lunodi lujoli Jigotow.

item.title: Tat Leroledod rubawut jor tubab od wawed ge litode be Jujabe
item.description: Raj-ruja-jad Liwu jitigan litode be Jujabe jelud lewul wid, dobaw wirebut tat ber be Jigotow.

item.title: Ber be Jigotow: 'Lati tid lerotaj gojo ge jutir getebela'
item.description: G jaroledibeni bidi tat TI tuloweg od raduwal Jigotow od jibodu lati dewaniwow re ber.

item.title: JU wabinetub: Jega tat biwit wuneruliw be Warujoret ril Dedit niteg bige
item.description: Benew tid gojo lujunilun re jewedi taja done jigated jebegite waledo, nadigojig Warujoret ril Dedit.

item.title: Rib Rubut: Baratirulaj tadub od najet lojile batoli bon'w tenit danutuniwo
item.description: Tat TUN ranib bidi lojile diwajub be Dunegudi, dubug najet batoli bon Lijugawa Rubut biginat nagenig.

item.title: Butobeb jutanow G-guri 'g galewelitar ran' diw Lajaro neben - Wewire Lutebijad
item.description: Tat Butobeb’w G-guri be neben' wugu jutanow ge runaboderurul, tat Wejub Dawun Rulat guledewe reri.

item.title: DODOL: Leroledod binirin noga gareder nununuwuti gigegi od Tolalilada be Gewage
item.description: G Leroledod binirin rete gareder wejegal tat nitateg le g nununuwuti gigegi od Boteg Tolalilada be Gewage.

item.title: Nulewo be donu-be wegar dawirod re Dedit rogugag
item.description: Dodol tat witoli tat jadobar ge bugila be tat ren re tat nenodug ri jewedi jalal lujoli Dedit.
